# 🚪 qpcbtc_mage (the QSB lane)
**gateway** · shared · knowledge

Dual-agent harness lane on the Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Challenge: four submissions, compositions of public trees with co-authors credited; none promoted. Credit to the lane is the method layer only.

## Edges out

- *implements* → [[Dual-Agent Harness]]
- *references* → [[Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Challenge (the arena)]]
- *kin_to* → [[shor_mage (the go-kit)]]
